name: Smoky Iron Ingot
summary: At the Windshear dig sites, kobolds smelt Smoky Iron Ingots from ore they pull from the Stonetalon Mountains. Orcish armorers prize the bars as raw material for sturdy mail gear for Horde warriors.

sections.title: Crude Kobold Metallurgy
sections.body: Kobolds smelt Smoky Iron Ingots in the Windshear Crag tunnels of the Stonetalon Mountains. They dig ore from the rocky slopes and heat it over crude, smoking fires. Residue and charcoal cling to the bars, but the metal remains dense and strong.

sections.title: Forging the Brutal Armor
sections.body: Thun'grim Firegaze, a near-blind orc armorer, works from a rugged camp overlooking the Barrens. He asks for these ingots to make armor for proven Horde warriors. Alongside refined iron bars, powdered azurite, and volatile phlogiston, the smoky metal forms a resilient core for Brutal Hauberks.

faq.q: Where do Smoky Iron Ingots come from?
aliases: where to find smoky iron ingot
faq.answer: Kobolds in the Windshear dig sites and tunnels of eastern Stonetalon Mountains carry Smoky Iron Ingots. They include diggers, stonecutters, vermin, geomancers, and their overlords.

faq.q: What are Smoky Iron Ingots used for?
aliases: what is smoky iron ingot for
faq.answer: Warriors answering Thun'grim Firegaze's call collect Smoky Iron Ingots. The master armorer lives on the peaks near Crossroads in the Barrens and needs fifteen ingots to forge the Brutal Hauberk.

faq.q: Why are the ingots described as 'smoky'?
faq.answer: Kobolds use crude, low-burning smelting fires in their dim tunnels. Soot, charcoal dust, and ash cling to the metal instead of leaving it with a clean shine.

faq.q: Can any blacksmith craft with these ingots?
aliases: is smoky iron a trade good
faq.answer: No. The irregular, soot-caked bars are not fit for standard trade blacksmithing. Only smiths such as Thun'grim Firegaze know how to work them into custom combat gear.

angles.text: For Horde warriors, gathering these ingots tests endurance in Stonetalon. They are needed to forge the Brutal Hauberk.
These ingots show the crude smelting methods kobold diggers use beside the refined techniques of trained smiths.
